detailed_descriptions.en: A larger, longer DLC pack with 100% more lions! Two Point Museum: Zooseum includes: - A brand new museum location - New expert type – Wildlife Experts - An unexplored expedition map – Farflung Isles - 40+ Wildlife Exhibits – Habitat animals & Terrarium animals - A new five star campaign to explore - New adorable gift shop items - 3 New interactive displays - New themed items and decorations - 2 new animal-related rooms - Habitat Enclosure and Wildlife Welfare Now hiring for Wildlife Experts to heal, raise and re-wild some wonderful wildlife in our brand new museum location! Two Point’s very own eccentric Kudoshillionaire Wiggy Silverbottom has permitted usage of his stately manor as a wildlife sanctuary for guests to come and enjoy while the animals are homed, healed and rehabilitated to be back in the wild. A Zooseum if you will. We need experts trained in a variety of exotic animals, diverse habitats, and that understand creatures with many, or sometimes no legs! 5 biome variants with corresponding flora, fauna and decorations for our habitats and terriariums will need careful upkeep to keep the ecosystems running smoothly. Staff must understand that each creature big and small will have very specific needs for each habitat, and don’t always get along… except the Unflappybara, they live in anywhere with anyone. Farflung Isles is diverse but struggling ecosystem and needs your help to heal the animals from Farflung flu. Rereleasing the animals will increase the biodiversity of Farflung Isles and earn Sanctuary Points, which can help the Zooseum adopt more animals in need of care. We expect only a regular amount of injuries will be sustained on expeditions… APPLY NOW!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A larger, longer DLC pack with 100% more lions! Two Point Museum: Zooseum includes:

- A brand new museum location

- New expert type – Wildlife Experts

- An unexplored expedition map – Farflung Isles

- 40+ Wildlife Exhibits – Habitat animals & Terrarium animals

- A new five star campaign to explore

- New adorable gift shop items

- 3 New interactive displays

- New themed items and decorations

- 2 new animal-related rooms - Habitat Enclosure and Wildlife Welfare

Now hiring for Wildlife Experts to heal, raise and re-wild some wonderful wildlife in our brand new museum location!

Two Point’s very own eccentric Kudoshillionaire Wiggy Silverbottom has permitted usage of his stately manor as a wildlife sanctuary for guests to come and enjoy while the animals are homed, healed and rehabilitated to be back in the wild. A Zooseum if you will.

We need experts trained in a variety of exotic animals, diverse habitats, and that understand creatures with many, or sometimes no legs!

5 biome variants with corresponding flora, fauna and decorations for our habitats and terriariums will need careful upkeep to keep the ecosystems running smoothly. Staff must understand that each creature big and small will have very specific needs for each habitat, and don’t always get along… except the Unflappybara, they live in anywhere with anyone.

Farflung Isles is diverse but struggling ecosystem and needs your help to heal the animals from Farflung flu. Rereleasing the animals will increase the biodiversity of Farflung Isles and earn Sanctuary Points, which can help the Zooseum adopt more animals in need of care. We expect only a regular amount of injuries will be sustained on expeditions…

APPLY NOW!
